fee_notes: Territory Fee is ongoing monthly, non-refundable, varies by franchise type and territory population ($200–$6,750/month). Brand Fund/Marketing Contribution is monthly ($500–$1,800). Referral Fee: 2–10% of referred gross sales (optional, franchisor discretionary). Technology Fee currently $300/month ($300–$900 range based on timing). Optional fees for SEO, website development, training, events, and insurance reimbursement also disclosed.
raw_excerpt: Territory Fee: Monthly amount based on your Territory population per Item 5. Due on the fifth day of each month. Brand Fund/Marketing Fund Contribution: Monthly amount based on your Territory population per Item 5. Due on the fifth day of each month. Referral Fee: Depending on the services referred, between 2% and 10% of Referral Gross Sales for jobs that we refer to you, once collected. Due within 30 days of collection. Technology Fee: Then-current fee (currently $300 per month). Due on the fifth day of each month.
